label: agent-reviewed exposed-cohort development diagnostic; not blinded, not human user research, not population accuracy
independence_disclosure: All individual judgments were determined from the frozen raw report and read-only DB before opening any peer score artifact. Before serialization, an unsolicited peer message arrived at 03:32:01Z disclosing aggregate counts (14 strict/21 useful) and qualitative notes on ICU09/11/28. These did not change the previously determined individual judgments; no peer per-case scores were consulted before this freeze. Therefore do not claim perfectly blinded scorer independence.
method: Read expected outcomes and all prefix outcomes from the immutable EC report, with repeated nested source/card structures de-duplicated for inspection. Reviewed actual displayed pages, continuations, inventory and comparison payloads; did not infer usefulness from machine assertions.

Read-only SQL independently checked 145 displayed candidate occurrences and 250 cited facet claims against their raw/official/correction evidence tables; zero unresolved source-fidelity mismatches. Narrow Mew ex affiliation independently checked against 11 unanimous exact Japanese base-name anchors.
No implementation/fixture edits or live mutable-runtime replay. Source fidelity was checked against the pinned catalog evidence, not a new independent visual reinspection or live marketplace audit.

Full completion can be achieved by a specifically precommitted clarification or guardrail operation. It is never awarded merely for safety on an unresolved acquisition/checklist goal. Relevance and completion remain separate axes, including duplicate-heavy pages with completed bounded feedback operations.
